notes.title: Save Data fix
notes.notes:
We’re sorry about the recent save issue. We’ve fixed it in the latest update, and new saves should now work correctly. If you still have problems, please try deleting your old saves here:

%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\DefaultCompany\Lustful Dead
